content.title: AT&T beats Q4 estimates, C3.ai pops on report of merger talks
content.description:
Market Catalysts Host Julie Hyman and Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre track several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including AT&T (T) topping fourth quarter earnings and revenue estimates, C3.ai (AI) stock reacting to headlines of a merger with Automation Anywhere reported by The Information, and Qorvo (QRVO) stock falling on disappointing fourth quarter revenue guidance.

content.title: QRVO Q4 Deep Dive: Strategic Portfolio Shifts Drive Margin Gains Amid Android Decline
content.summary: Communications chips maker Qorvo (NASDAQ: QRVO) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q4 CY2025, with sales up 8.4% year on year to $993 million. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $800 billion, coming in 88,732% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.17 per share was 16.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
